subject: Future Tech
title: Waymo: The Front-Runner
description: A fast breakdown of Waymo: The Front-Runner for builders.

hook.text: Waymo started as Google's self-driving project in 2009. Fifteen years and $5.

buildup.text: Waymo chose the hard path: full Level 4 autonomy from day one. No driver assists, no half-measures, true self-driving.

discovery.text: Waymo's fleet now covers San Francisco, Phoenix, and LA.

twist.text: Waymo has spent more than any competitor and still isn't profitable.

climax.text: Alphabet invested $5.7 billion in 2025 alone. Waymo's bet: once coverage expands, network effects create a monopoly.

punchline.text: First to market, still burning cash, and still leading.

quiz.question: What approach did Waymo take to autonomy?
options: Full Level 4 autonomy from the start
